<?php
class NullableReadName {
    public function __get(?string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === "12" ? "NSTR;" : "BAD;";
        $incoming = null;
        echo $incoming === null ? "NNULL;" : "BAD;";
        return 7;
    }
}
class UnionReadName {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === "12" ? "USTR;" : "BAD;";
        $incoming = 9;
        echo $incoming === 9 ? "UINT;" : "BAD;";
        return 11;
    }
}
class MixedReadName {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming) {
        echo $incoming === "literal" ? "MSTR;" : "BAD;";
        $incoming = false;
        echo $incoming === false ? "MBOOL;" : "BAD;";
        return 13;
    }
}
$name = "12";
$o = new NullableReadName;
echo ($o->$name) === 7 ? "VALUE;" : "BAD;";
$o = new UnionReadName;
echo $o->$name;
echo ";";
$o = new MixedReadName;
$o->literal;
echo "DONE;";
